name: Vyten
blurb: A hillside sandbox: the author's whole map.
author: Raxten
attribution: Converted from gm_vyten, https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1449731878 by Raxten. Drawn from the map's own geometry with free (CC0) textures and stand-in models, listed in its world pack's credits; the author's textures and models are not carried. The author can have this conversion removed: contact https://github.com/zees-games/playlot-maps/issues.
